question: At fixed longer node work, does the unchanged exact-river candidate reach the historical medium/dry absolute quality gates, and does it still beat the unchanged q8 control at matched work?
crossing: first complete iteration at or above each label, with exact uniform initialization charged and overshoot retained
trainer: unchanged IID B4 external sampling, batch size 4, signed regrets, linear regret and average weights, target order 0 then 1; independently restart each arm/seed from its fixed seed, no saved-policy warm start
primary_metric: exact restricted-game NashConv/2 exploitability as fraction of initial pot, lower is better
paired_metric: candidate minus control exploitability fraction at the same work crossing for each seed; report every seed and median
diagnostic_metrics: both-seat additive saved-prefix best-response-loss contributions in chips at the three preselected turn exact information rows; aggregate turn and river contributions across all rows; report each seed/arm/checkpoint and the fixed-opponent/optimized-own-continuation assumptions; these are diagnostic decompositions, not universal action values

decision.positive: at 100m linear average candidate passes all absolute gates and paired seed median <= -0.001 initial pots
decision.negative: at 100m candidate fails an absolute gate or paired seed median >= +0.001 initial pots
decision.inconclusive: other complete outcome; failed source, admission or numerical gates stop with retained evidence

profile.forecast: for each of six paths take maximum of three construction-through-replay whole times scaled by 100m/actual work, sum in fixed index-modulo-three worker partitions, T=max sum; require strict 2*(2*T+600)<7200

publication: prospective protocol before new measurements; isolated tested source and exact-source local/optional/hosted qualification before synthetic proof; publish and byte-verify proof before profile; publish and verify full profile and separate admission before own long run; publish and byte-verify complete or partial own raw before comparison-only OpenSpiel audit; final exact-source checks
reference: pinned OpenSpiel 2.0.2 Apache-2.0 comparison-only scalar audit, 1e-9 chips; no reference strategy in own training
stop_rule: one fixed six-path run; retain every complete or partial result; no seed search, unfavorable retry, extension, representation change, default promotion or budget/threshold change
